name: Blood Blush
source:
Charlotte, a hungry vampire, finds herself working later than usual when Roy, a human familiar, enlists her help to fix a broken machine.

[from [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/bloodblush]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
饥饿的吸血鬼夏洛特发现自己比平时工作得晚，而人类使魔罗伊则请求夏洛特帮忙修理一台坏掉的机器。

[来自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/bloodblush]itch.io[/url]]
